title: SHADOW MOSES · CANYON
reviewNotes: Recessed northern warhead storage gate, grey segmented facade, right service cylinders and enclosed snowy rock basin match the inspected original map landmarks.
No tank or characters baked into the scenery; separate existing M1 rig can be linked by Root.
Lateral camera and clear snow fighting plane are CQC adaptations. Exact original PS1 pixel/color fidelity is not certified.
